personal_info.name: Muhammad Hassan Siddiqui
personal_info.title: Principal Software Engineer
personal_info.tagline: I make backends fast, reliable, and ready for the next 10× of growth.

about_me.text: {years}+ years building backend systems that hold up in production. My specialty is high-stakes data work — migrating millions of records with zero data loss, and scaling products from alpha to 100k+ users on Python, Django, and AWS. I've shipped across ed-tech, sports analytics, and loyalty platforms; these days I lead teams, own architecture decisions, and build LLM-powered features. Mostly I sweat the unglamorous things that keep systems alive: clean data models, fast pipelines, and deploys that don't wake you at 2am.

highlights: Lead architecture across client products including Toastmasters International's data-migration platform (6–7M member, club, and program records), Supercal's AI email scheduling, and Search Atlas's SEO Report Builder.

Design and ship backend features end-to-end — schema, APIs, task queues, and deployment — including a rule-based validation engine that gates data quality across millions of records before migration cutover.
Mentor a rotating group of ~10 engineers; several have moved from first production-scale codebase to independent feature ownership.

Coordinate technical planning and release delivery across 10–15 engineers per cycle; led the 4-month Toastmasters migration program from design through cutover, cutting full-migration runtime from 30+ hours to 4–5 hours.
Designed and shipped APIs powering the Entertainer and Munch consumer apps (6M+ users at the time).
Built Selenium scrapers that pulled 45k+ outlet records across ~22 countries.
Cut the initial catalog sync from over a month to ~1 week via multi-threading, with on-demand updates thereafter.
Built a gamification game where users earn and redeem coins.
Designed backend architecture and APIs powering mobile apps and admin dashboards across multiple clients.
Engineered performance-scoring algorithms for basketball shooting drills in the Ballogy app.
Led the engineering team through planning, delivery, and cross-team coordination.
Owned production deployments and live-server monitoring for the team's products.
Shipped new features and change requests against client specifications.
Wrote unit and functional tests to keep the codebase stable across releases.
Contributed to early-career research spanning QEMU hardware emulation, network-security tooling, and software-defined networking (SDN).

projects.name: Search Atlas — Report Builder
projects.description: SEO platform offering a suite of tools. I own the Report Builder module, which composes reports from integrated data modules (Google Search Console, Business Profile, Ads, Analytics, Meta Ads, LLM Performance, Keyword Report, AI SEO) with AI-generated summaries, flexible layouts, email scheduling, and report/presentation export.
contributions: Redesigned the entire Report Builder module for flexibility and robustness, using caching to cut page-load time for larger reports from 10–15s to ~5s.
Optimized presentation generation from ~3 minutes to under 1 minute.
Built AI-generated summaries for individual data modules and for the full report and portfolio.
Lead a 2-person team on the module.

projects.name: Video Proctoring Tool
projects.description: Internal company service, integrated across multiple in-house products, that analyzes candidate posture during video interviews (looking straight, left/right, or out of frame) to flag potential cheating.
contributions: Led a complete architectural redesign of the service.
Replaced ad-hoc JSON-file/Redis storage with PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy, and added a storage layer configurable between S3 and local filesystem for video frames.
Added a Client model with client-ID-based authentication to isolate per-client data on a previously unauthenticated API.
Replaced FastAPI BackgroundTasks with a Taskiq queue, added API versioning, an admin panel, documentation, and CI pipelines, and raised test coverage from 0 to 90%+.

projects.name: Toastmasters International — Data Migration
projects.description: Data migration platform for Toastmasters International — moving member, club, and program data from a legacy system to a new platform across a global network of clubs.
contributions: Built the migration pipelines that moved member, club, and program data off the legacy system.
Cut full-migration runtime from 30+ hours to 4–5 hours (~6–7× faster) through query optimization, factory-based foreign-key caching, chunk-size tuning, and parallel task execution.
Designed a rule-based validation engine that flagged data-quality issues and produced reports across data points.
Built a data-cleaning framework that enforced integrity before records reached the new platform.
Architected the migration to run at scale — batched, resumable, and safe to re-run on failures.

projects.name: Advance Learning World
projects.description: Ed-tech platform serving schools and individual learners with personalized learning paths, progress reporting, and recommendation tools.
contributions: Added multi-tenant support so schools could onboard as B2B clients alongside individual learners.
Architected and load-tested the platform for 100k+ concurrent users, optimizing across the stack to meet the target.
Shipped weekly progress reports for students and a separate reporting view for B2B teachers.
Built a recommendation engine that surfaced each student's weakest areas for focused practice.
Built a shared question bank spanning teacher and student workflows.
Built the end-of-year promotion system that advanced students to the next grade.

projects.name: Ballogy
projects.description: Sports analytics platform for basketball — skill assessment, development tracking, and coaching tools.
contributions: Built the shooting-test management system that captures and scores basketball drills.
Built the coach panel that lets coaches track, compare, and evaluate athletes.
Grew the product from alpha to 100k+ users, driving architecture decisions and re-architecting deployment to Docker + AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, ECS, S3, RDS) with Jenkins CI as traffic scaled.
Recovered a full database loss from backup with zero data lost and hardened the server against future breaches.

projects.name: Supercal
projects.description: Email-based meeting scheduler (beta) that uses GPT-4 to read participant replies and converge a group on a meeting time without manual back-and-forth. Built on Django + AWS, integrating Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar APIs.
contributions: Improved the GPT-4 email-parsing layer on a pre-existing codebase, cutting its error rate from ~30% to ~10%.
Redesigned prompt management from raw Python strings to Jinja2 templates, making prompts far easier to design, maintain, and iterate on.

projects.name: Eaziex
projects.description: Classified-ads platform with a flexible, category-specific form and filter engine — each ad category defines its own fields and its own searchable filters.
contributions: Designed the full backend architecture from scratch.
Built a form-management system that lets admins compose a different ad form per category.
Built the matching filter engine so each category's ads could be searched by its own fields.
Built the customer-facing frontend in ReactJS and NextJS.

projects.name: The Entertainer
projects.description: Consumer lifestyle and rewards app offering 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' dining, entertainment, and hospitality benefits across multiple international markets.
contributions: Built and maintained the backend APIs powering the consumer apps (6M+ users at the time) — accounts, offer catalogs, redemptions, and merchant data.
Built Selenium scrapers that pulled 45k+ outlet records across ~22 countries; cut the initial full sync from over a month to ~1 week via multi-threading, with on-demand updates thereafter.
Built a gamification game where users earn and redeem coins.
Owned data-modelling and migration work in MySQL as the catalog grew across new markets and offer types.

projects.name: WorkSTEPS
projects.description: B2B occupational health platform giving clinicians and employers digital tools to schedule, conduct, and analyze functional capacity evaluations (FCEs) and pre-employment testing.
contributions: Implemented a strict password and authentication policy — complexity rules, blocking reuse of the last 5 passwords, blocking personal-info and dictionary words, and security-question-based reset — to support the platform's compliance requirements.
Migrated 100k+ records from a legacy WordPress-based system into the Django rewrite via custom ETL pipelines.
